selected_evidence.requirement: node2->node3 connection observed by node3 as arriving from a node1 address, not node2's own address
selected_evidence.summary: tcpdump on node3's enp8s0 during a live TCP session from node2 shows the connection sourced from 10.50.20.1 (node1's lan-b/opt2 address), not node2's real address 10.50.10.11

selected_evidence.requirement: reverse direction (node3->node2) keeps original source address
selected_evidence.summary: tcpdump on node2's enp8s0 during a live TCP session from node3 shows the connection sourced from node3's real address 10.50.20.12, unmodified
